snippet.title: The Last Tale Told: Spam - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Add The Last Tale Told: Spam to your Steam Wishlist NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4133490/The_Last_Tale_Told_Spam

You live alone. Work from home. You haven't been out for days, trapped by endless rain. Every day your phone rings, it's an unknown number. “Possible fraud” is what you read on the screen. You think it's just spam.

Music credits :
